description: Add a comment to a pull request (repositoryId optional; derived from pullRequestId when omitted)

content.description: The content of the comment in markdown

filePath.description: The path of the file to comment on (for new thread on file)

lineNumber.description: The line number to comment on (for new thread on file)

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

parentCommentId.description: ID of the parent comment when replying to an existing comment

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

pullRequestId.description: The ID of the pull request

repositoryId.description: The ID or name of the repository (optional; derived from pullRequestId when omitted)

status.description: The status to set for a new thread

threadId.description: The ID of the thread to add the comment to

name: add_pull_request_comment
